newsitem.title: UK: CBI has doubts about proposed new UK strike curbs.
newsitem.headline: CBI has doubts about proposed new UK strike curbs.

text.p: The Confederation of British Industry (CBI) expressed doubts on Tuesday about whether the government's planned new curbs on strikes would work.
Trade Secretary Ian Lang earlier proposed lifting trade unions' legal immunity so they could be sued if a strike had "disproportionate" or "excessive" effects.
The CBI, Britain's leading employers' group, welcomed the fact that the government is keeping the issue under review.
"We will need to study the proposals in detail in consultation with members, though our initial soundings suggest that there is doubt about whether they are workable," it said.
It said the terms "disproportionate" and "excessive" would need to be properly prescribed if the proposal is to progress.
